referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A full-width interior photograph carries a very large white serif studio title along its bottom edge; the next cream band gives a short craft statement. A small emblem on the left and compact uppercase portfolio, studio, shop, news and contact links on a cream top line. Expressive high-contrast serif display and section titles paired with small, measured body copy; typography feels like an interiors journal. The page sequence runs from room photograph and oversized title to cream craft statement to three-image discipline gateway toward news and views collage, project enquiry, terracotta footer. Immersive furnished-room photographs, three adjacent feature images, a maker portrait, material close-ups and image-led news chapters. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
